class.name: GameplayPredictionInput
class.description: GameplayPredictionInput contains only player intent, a monotonic sequence, and the configured simulation step. It never carries position, velocity, ownership, or other authority state.

method.name: to_dictionary
method.description: Returns the transport-safe sequence, input vector components, and step duration.

members.member: Normalized movement intent. Lengths greater than one are rejected by the prediction model.
Monotonic per-object input sequence. Zero is invalid for simulation.
